item.description: Mourners have buried four members of a family, including three children, killed in Jordanian airstrikes in Syria.

item.description: The Iran war and Trump's criticisms of allies have led Asia-Pacific countries to recalibrate their calculations.

item.title: Netherlands pulls out of Eurovision again over Israel participation
